payload.reason: The evidence provides specific models explored in the paper related to fake news detection and classification using machine learning algorithms.

claims.text: The paper explores various machine learning models including convolutional neural networks (CNN), recurrent neural networks (RNN), feed-forward neural networks (FFNN), long-short term memory (LSTM), and logistic regression for fake news classification.
Pretrained algorithms such as TFIDF, CV, and W2V are used for processing textual data in the context of fake news detection.
